crossRefs.note: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by…
James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew…
He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

translations.web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
translations.bsb: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
translations.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
translations.asv: And going on a little further, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.
